info.description: API for VitalFit, a gym system management
info.title: VitalFit API

put.description: Activates a user's account using the invitation code/token.

204.description: User successfully activated. No content returned.

404.description: Code is invalid or expired (handled by the service layer returning ErrNotFound)

500.description: Internal server error (e.g., database connection issue)

post.description: Authenticates the user with email and password, returning an access token upon success.
post.summary: Logs in a user and issues a JWT token

404.description: error":	"not found"							"User with the given email not found

500.description: error":	"the server encountered a problem"	"Internal server error during token generation or hashing

post.description: Envía un código OTP al correo electrónico proporcionado para iniciar el proceso de reseteo de contraseña.
post.summary: Solicitar token de reseteo de contraseña

parameters.description: Estructura que contiene el correo del usuario
parameters.name: email

200.description: Si el correo existe, el proceso de token ha sido exitoso (por seguridad, el mensaje no confirma la existencia del correo).

400.description: Bad Request - Datos de entrada inválidos (ej. formato de email incorrecto)

500.description: Internal Server Error - Error al generar el token, al acceder a la DB, o al enviar el correo.

post.description: Finalizes the password reset process by validating the token and updating the user's password hash.

parameters.description: Reset token and new password data (must include password confirmation).
parameters.name: body

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid data (expired token, token not found, or passwords do not match).

500.description: Internal Server Error - Error while hashing the password or executing the DB transaction.
